$comment: Machine-readable form of ADR-0050 / ADR-0052 / ADR-0053. This file is normative: tools/check-language-map.py enforces it in the gate, and a layer that is not declared here cannot be added. Prose lives in docs/DECISIONS.md; when the two disagree, the ADR wins and this file is the bug.

deployment.primary: native host or the Electron desktop app
deployment.secondary: container stack (Docker Compose), kept for operators who already run one
deployment.note: The product is not a hosted web service. A native install is a venv, two systemd user units and a database on the operator's own machine; the desktop app is the same API and web bundle inside Electron.

rust.owns: the trust boundary, deterministic kernels, the shipped CLI and every node-facing transport
rust.integration: PyO3 in-process for kernels; a loopback socket for the signer
rust.rule: A Python module in a Rust-owned layer is a review failure. A Rust crate that nothing links is frozen, not shipped.

python.owns: business logic, orchestration, the product HTTP and WebSocket surface, integrations, analytics, AI/ML, strategy plugins, developer tooling
python.integration: FastAPI/ASGI in-process; the compiled bridge only through the declared clients
python.rule: Money arithmetic stays in Python until decimal parity is proven per kernel. No float arithmetic in a money path.

typescript.owns: the dashboard and every product UI surface, including the desktop renderer
typescript.rule: The renderer never receives the API token, never computes money and never holds a key.

ezchain_core.role: domain types, money, ledger, risk policy, reason codes
ezchain_core.reason: The living oracle for every parity fixture and the only accountant (CONTRACT I1). Ownership is the asset.

ezchain_adapters.role: venue and chain adapters, market data normalisation
ezchain_adapters.reason: Remote provider deadlines dominate. A compiled rewrite cannot shorten a network timeout.

ezchain_sdk.reason: A stranger's first plugin must stay approachable.

ezchain_ingest.role: market data acquisition, retention and the pump.fun firehose seam
ezchain_ingest.reason: I/O orchestration over a Python client. The firehose stays Python: it is an integration, not a trust boundary.

ezchain_engine.reason: Control plane over subprocess workers. The only Rust candidate is a clock kernel, and only if a profile asks.

ezchain_executor.role: execution pipeline, gates, receipts, signer seam
ezchain_executor.reason: The orchestration is Python; the pure kernels behind it are Rust. The signer itself is a separate Rust process.

ezchain_agent_runtime.role: the built-in agent runtime, speaking only MCP
ezchain_agent_runtime.reason: Model clients and tool policy are Python-first, and the runtime holds no I/O of its own.

ezchain_harness.role: model provider registry and stress harness

ezchain_api.role: the product HTTP API, WebSocket gateway and the in-process engine host
ezchain_api.reason: 83 routes, auth, rate limits and observability already exist here. A Rust rewrite of the edge buys nothing a server swap would not.

ezchain_mcp.role: MCP surface over the product API
ezchain_mcp.reason: A thin adapter over the API. Not a language decision.

python_entry_points.reason: The API's only compiled-bridge client; money and scope kernels cross here.
The executor is a separate deployable and cannot import the API's client.

shipping.ezchain-bridge: the PyO3 extension the product imports, built by tools/build-native.sh
shipping.ezchain-cli: the read-only operator CLI; it builds and passes its tests, and no installer or desktop resource list ships it yet (RUST-08)
shipping.ezchain-core: pure deterministic kernels, linked by the bridge
shipping.ezchain-decimal: arbitrary-precision money, parity-proven against money.py, linked by the bridge
shipping.ezchain-jsoncanon: canonical JSON for seals and fingerprints, linked by decimal
shipping.ezchain-rpc: the wire contract; the bridge links only its method and scopes kernels

frozen.ezchain-p2p: no second machine must agree on one tape exists
frozen.ezchain-consensus: ADR-0051 is Proposed and the product has no validator set
frozen.ezchain-rpc-server: it serves health acks only, and the product contract is the OpenAPI snapshot

shipping_unwired.ezchain-seal: the tape seal is proven against fixtures and has no Python caller; ledger.py seals with its own implementation. Wiring it is the highest-value remaining Rust work, because a kernel nothing calls cannot be the thing that makes the tape tamper-evident.
shipping_unwired.ezchain-replay: same as ezchain-seal: the deterministic projection is proven and never called.
shipping_unwired.ezchain-fingerprint: linked only by ezchain-seal, so it inherits the seal's missing caller.
shipping_unwired.ezchain-executor: pure execution kernels that nothing links; the executor service runs its Python pipeline.
shipping_unwired.ezchain-protection: pure protection kernels that nothing links; the engine evaluates protection in Python.
shipping_unwired.ezchain-scheduler: pure scheduling kernels that nothing links; the engine schedules in Python.
shipping_unwired.ezchain-flow: it composes executor, protection and scheduler, so it is unwired for the same reason all three are.

rust_crates.unfreeze_condition: A second, independently operated machine must agree on the same ordered tape. Not a federation ambition; a machine that exists, runs, and must not diverge.

binaries.ezchain-cli: read-only operator CLI; built and tested, not yet in any installer release

apps/web.role: the product UI and its token-injecting BFF

apps/desktop.role: the Electron shell that supervises the API and web sidecars

languages.reason: Three languages are the budget. A fourth needs its own ADR, not a commit.

rust_in_ui.reason: The UI is TypeScript. Rust reaches it only through the Python API.

python_in_ui.reason: No second set of rules and no server code inside the renderer. The one sanctioned exception is the frozen sidecar entrypoint apps/desktop/backend_entry.py, which is the same FastAPI app the server deployment runs, not a second implementation.

token_in_renderer.reason: The token reaches the API through the server-side proxy only (CONTRACT I4). A client component that reads process.env.EZCHAIN_API_TOKEN would embed it in the browser bundle.

float_money.reason: Exact decimal arithmetic only; a float has already lost the amount (ADR-0046).

pumpfire.reason: pumpfun-firehose is an optional MIT extra consumed by the adapter and the ingest source. Nothing else may import it, so the API image stays free of it.

known_violations.reason: The ORM rows live in apps/api/models.py. The engine should import a shared model package instead; until then the inversion is recorded, not blessed. The list may only shrink.
known_violations.fix: Move the shared rows into a lower package and drop this entry.

known_violations.reason: Same cause as the engine inversion: market rows and settings live in apps/api. The list may only shrink.
known_violations.fix: Same fix as the engine inversion.

money_parity.rule: A kernel flips to Rust only when every recorded case matches for class, message and code, and the benchmark is measured on whole work units. A single small call is not evidence.

switch_triggers.product_api_to_rust: Never. The ASGI edge is the product. Replacing the server (Granian) is the permitted move.
switch_triggers.granian: A measured p99 that is attributable to uvicorn rather than the handler.
switch_triggers.tauri: The WebKitGTK build passes the whole Playwright suite with no rendering regression.
switch_triggers.duckdb: Analytics outgrows SQLite or Postgres in a measured query, and a second concurrent writer is not needed.
switch_triggers.wasm_plugins: A strategy authored by someone who is not the operator must run in the same process tree.
switch_triggers.local_vault: Users measurably refuse external signers. Until then external-signer-first, and no vault.json.
